questions.question: What is the time complexity of searching in a balanced Binary Search Tree (BST)?
questions.hint: A balanced BST has a height of O(log n), so searching takes O(log n) time.

questions.question: Which layer in the OSI model is responsible for routing packets?
questions.hint: The Network Layer is responsible for routing packets across network boundaries.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a transaction property in DBMS?
questions.hint: The ACID properties are Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, and Durability.

questions.question: What is the binary equivalent of decimal number 25?
questions.hint: 25 in binary is 16 + 8 + 1, which corresponds to 11001.

questions.question: Which scheduling algorithm can result in starvation?
questions.hint: Shortest Job First can starve longer jobs if short jobs keep arriving.

questions.question: A page fault occurs when:
options: The page is in main memory
The page is not in main memory
An error occurs in page table
questions.hint: A page fault occurs when an active program requests a memory page that is not currently loaded in the RAM.

questions.question: Which logic gate is equivalent to Boolean multiplication?
questions.hint: The AND gate performs Boolean multiplication (Y = A . B).

questions.question: How many states are required in a minimal DFA that accepts all binary strings of even length?
questions.hint: A minimal DFA requires 2 states: an accepting state for even length and a non-accepting state for odd length.

questions.question: Which SQL command is used to remove a table structure along with its data?
questions.hint: DROP TABLE removes the table definition and all its rows, indices, and constraints.

questions.question: What is the default TCP port number for HTTP?
questions.hint: HTTP defaults to port 80, while HTTPS uses port 443.

questions.question: Which protocol translates a logical IP address into a physical MAC address?
questions.hint: ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) maps dynamic IP addresses to physical hardware MAC addresses on a local network.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a linear data structure?
questions.hint: Trees and Graphs are non-linear hierarchical data structures.

questions.question: What is the postfix expression of the infix string: A + B?
questions.hint: The postfix notation places operators after their operands (AB+).

questions.question: Virtual memory is primarily based on which hardware/software concept?
questions.hint: Virtual memory is commonly implemented using demand paging.

questions.question: Which sorting algorithm has a best-case time complexity of O(n log n) and is non-recursive?
questions.hint: Merge Sort uses a divide-and-conquer strategy guaranteeing O(n log n) comparisons in all cases.
